keyword.en: electric 30 vs low pressure 40 concrete pump
keyword.zh: 电动30和电动低压40的区别

title.en: 12–15 m³/h stays on the Electric 30 vs Electric Low Pressure 40 page
title.zh: 12–15 m³/h仍写在电动30和电动低压40混凝土泵有何不同这一页

description.en: Electric 30 vs Electric Low Pressure 40. 12–15 m³/h stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Barometer.
description.zh: 电动30和电动低压40混凝土泵有何不同。12–15 m³/h仍在目录格子里。插图来自「气压表」。

h1.en: 12–15 m³/h stays on the Electric 30 vs Electric Low Pressure 40 page
h1.zh: 12–15 m³/h仍写在电动30和电动低压40混凝土泵有何不同这一页

directAnswer.en: Electric 30 and Electric Low Pressure 40 are Hebei Pinjin Machinery concrete pumps in Xingtai. Both list 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, a 0.3 m³ hopper, 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm and 1200 kg. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barometer.
directAnswer.zh: 电动30和电动低压40是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。两边都标出 12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、料斗 0.3 m³、外形 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm、1200 kg。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barometer。

body.en: Downloaded from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barometer. The image subject is Dosen barometer. Electric 30 and Electric Low Pressure 40 are Hebei Pinjin Machinery concrete pumps in Xingtai. Motor power: Electric 30 lists 30 kW. Electric Low Pressure 40 lists 37 kW. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. The words low pressure in the name do not replace the 20 MPa entry, which matches Electric 30. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 此图下载自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barometer。画面内容是Dosen barometer。电动30和电动低压40是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。细石输送（水平/垂直）：电动30标出 60 m / 180 m；电动低压40标出 80 m / 240 m。电动低压40有、电动30没有的行：液压泵 Kawasaki 112。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

body.en: Both list 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, a 0.3 m³ hopper, 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm and 1200 kg. Fine-stone pumping (H / V): Electric 30 lists 60 m / 180 m. Electric Low Pressure 40 lists 80 m / 240 m. Electric 30 lists entries that Electric Low Pressure 40 does not: Aggregate-13 pumping (H / V) 20 m / 60 m. Max. aggregate size ≤ 3 cm. Open /en/products/electric-30-concrete-pump/ for Electric 30 and /en/products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump/ for Electric Low Pressure 40.
body.zh: 两边都标出 12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、料斗 0.3 m³、外形 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm、1200 kg。同一标题下数值相同的有：理论输送量两边都是 12–15 m³/h；最大出口压力两边都是 20 MPa；料斗容积两边都是 0.3 m³。名称里的「低压」不能代替 20 MPa 这一格，这一格与电动30相同。

body.en: Electric 30 lists a 30 kW motor and two stone-distance rows. The same shown value on a shared label: Theoretical output is 12–15 m³/h on both pages. Max. outlet pressure is 20 MPa on both pages. Hopper capacity is 0.3 m³ on both pages. Electric Low Pressure 40 lists entries that Electric 30 does not: Hydraulic pump Kawasaki 112. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 低压40标出 37 kW、细石 80 m / 240 m 和川崎112，没有骨料粒径行。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。看电动30请打开 /zh/products/electric-30-concrete-pump/，看电动低压40请打开 /zh/products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump/。

body.en: Low Pressure 40 lists 37 kW, fine-stone 80 m / 240 m and a Kawasaki 112, with no aggregate-size row. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 电机功率：电动30标出 30 kW；电动低压40标出 37 kW。电动30有、电动低压40没有的行：13骨料输送（水平/垂直） 20 m / 60 m；最大骨料粒径 ≤ 3 cm。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

question.en: Does Electric 30 list the same motor power as Electric Low Pressure 40?
question.zh: 电动30和电动低压40的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 30 lists 30 kW. Electric Low Pressure 40 lists 37 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barometer.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动30标出 30 kW。电动低压40标出 37 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barometer画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 30 list the same fine-stone pumping (h / v) as Electric Low Pressure 40?
question.zh: 电动30和电动低压40的细石输送（水平/垂直）一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 30 lists 60 m / 180 m. Electric Low Pressure 40 lists 80 m / 240 m. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barometer.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动30标出 60 m / 180 m。电动低压40标出 80 m / 240 m。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barometer画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is aggregate-13 pumping (h / v) missing on Electric Low Pressure 40?
question.zh: 为什么电动低压40没有13骨料输送（水平/垂直）？

answer.en: The Electric Low Pressure 40 page does not list that label. Electric 30 lists 20 m / 60 m. Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barometer.
answer.zh: 电动低压40这一页没有标出这个标题。电动30标出的是 20 m / 60 m。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barometer画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Where is the hydraulic pump for Electric Low Pressure 40 shown?
question.zh: 电动低压40的液压泵标出在哪里？

answer.en: It is shown on /en/products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump/ as Kawasaki 112. It is not shown as that label on the Electric 30 page. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barometer.
answer.zh: 标出在 /zh/products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump/，数值为 Kawasaki 112。电动30页面没有这个标题。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barometer画面里印出的数字。
